extra.message: The unauthenticated password-reset action returns a usable resetUrl for the submitted email. An attacker can request a victim's reset token, submit it with a new password, and take over the account. The demo behavior has no environment guard.

cwe: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password

extra.message: searchAuditTrailAdvanced interpolates term and entityType directly into SQL passed to prisma.$queryRawUnsafe. The admin audit loader supplies advancedTerm and advancedEntityType query parameters without SQL escaping. Crafted quotes and SQL expressions can alter the query and retrieve other database records; the sort allowlist does not protect these values.

The expression argument is compiled and executed with Function in the server process. api.matters.tsx passes the caller's x-aging-expression header directly to this helper. A valid API-key holder with an accessible matter can execute arbitrary JavaScript, including reading process.env, despite the key being issued for read-only data access.

Template placeholders are executed through new Function without a sandbox or expression allowlist. The reports loader passes the letterWording query parameter through renderCustomCoverLetterHtml to this compiler. Staff can submit expressions such as {{JSON.stringify(process.env)}} to expose server secrets or execute arbitrary JavaScript.

renderFilingCopy interpolates format into an execSync shell command, including an unquoted --to argument. The document conversion loader supplies the format query parameter without validation. Any user permitted to read a document, including a client, can inject shell commands or command substitutions.

renderExhibitQuickLook inserts declaredExtension into a command executed with shell:true. The upload-version action derives this value from rawFile.name, rather than the sanitized saved filename. A document editor can upload an allowed MIME type with shell metacharacters after the final filename dot and execute commands on the server.

templateName is joined to the intake template directory and read without a containment check. The new-matter loader supplies the intakeTemplate query parameter and returns the file contents as templatePreview. An attorney can use ../ segments to read server files outside the template directory, including configuration files.

The timeline action passes the submitted exhibitLabel directly into path.join and writeFile. There is no basename normalization or directory containment check. A staff member who can edit a matter can submit ../ segments to write uploaded bytes outside its exhibit directory and overwrite files writable by the application.

parseCourierHandoff decodes the token payload without verifying its HMAC signature. The unauthenticated court.filing-receipts action accepts this token in x-access-token and uses its fields to mark a deadline completed. An attacker can forge receipts and modify filing status without possessing the courier secret.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: The docket reader resolves attacker-supplied SYSTEM entities using fetch or readFile and substitutes their contents into the feed. A matter editor can submit a controlled feed through sync-status-feed, reference a local file inside an entry's status, and retrieve the expanded contents from the matter timeline audit entries. HTTP entities also permit requests to internal services.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The timeline's docketUrl form value reaches fetch without restrictions on destination hosts or private addresses. The response body is written into public/exhibits and its publicPath is returned. A matter editor can request internal HTTP services and retrieve their responses through the public exhibit file.

Both docket ingestion functions fetch the caller-supplied feedUrl without restricting destinations. The timeline action reaches ingestCourtStatusFeed, and the docket-crossref action reaches ingestCourtStatusFeedVerified even for client users with matter access. Rejecting DOCTYPE does not prevent requests to loopback, private-network, or other internal HTTP endpoints.

The sync-exhibit-manifest action passes submitted JSON directly as Prisma document update data. Document editors can modify ownership and security fields such as matterId, uploadedById, and visibility, or submit nested relation operations, instead of being limited to exhibit metadata. Authorization is checked only against the original document.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: recordConflictClearance spreads the entire submitted form into a client update; the caller removes only intent and memoLabel. An assigned attorney can supply portalUserId to relink the client to another account, granting that account access to all matters belonging to the client. Contact and clearance editing therefore permits unauthorized changes to portal ownership.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: The loader checks only that the requester is logged in, then fetches and returns a note by its supplied ID. fetchNoteRecord does not enforce matter ownership or note visibility. Any authenticated user, including a client, can read another matter's internal privileged note when its ID is known.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: The edit action authorizes changes solely by matching note.authorId to user.id. It never checks current matter access or archived status. A former assignee can continue changing their notes after removal from the matter, including changing an internal note to CLIENT_VISIBLE; non-admin authors can also modify archived matters.

close-matter-tasks forwards the submitted matterId to bulkCloseMatterTasks without checking matter access or editability. Any staff user can complete all active tasks on an unrelated or archived matter. The close-my-tasks branch at lines 105-107 likewise omits current matter access and archive checks, although it restricts updates to the caller's assigned tasks.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: The supplied deadlineReference is interpolated into the regular expression used to select from every deadline in the database. A value such as .*|.* introduces an alternative that matches unrelated matters. The selected record, including confidential notes, is returned as referencedDeadline to any user with access to the initial matter, including clients.

A requester controls the regular expression executed synchronously against database deadline identifiers. Nested repetitions with a failing suffix, such as (.+)+!, can cause catastrophic backtracking on an existing identifier. There is no pattern restriction or execution timeout, allowing an authenticated client to block the server event loop.

For a CLIENT on their own STANDARD or CONFIDENTIAL matter, the final expression returns true because the client is not a PARALEGAL. The matter action uses this helper to authorize approve-message and revise-draft-message. A client who knows a draft ID can approve an internal draft and make it visible in their portal without staff approval.

The UI disables external sharing for privileged, attorney-client, and work-product documents, but the action checks only that visibility is a valid enum. A document editor can directly POST visibility=CLIENT_SHARED or PUBLIC_FILING to expose a restricted document to clients, bypassing isRestrictedFromExternalExport.

cwe: CWE-602: Client-Side Enforcement of Server-Side Security

extra.message: resolveMatterReviewLink verifies the signature but ignores the signed exp field. The public matter review route consequently accepts expired links indefinitely. Tokens issued for review-secure use the same signing format and can also be replayed against the unenforced review route after expiration.

Logout only sends a cookie-deletion response for a stateless session containing userId. getUserId and getCurrentUser have no revocation, session-version, or issuance-time check, and password reset changes only passwordHash. A copied valid authentication cookie therefore remains usable after logout or password reset while the user remains active.

deepMergeRules recursively follows inherited target properties and accepts __proto__ without filtering. The update-automation-rules action supplies parsed user JSON. An override containing an object under __proto__ writes its properties onto Object.prototype, allowing a matter editor to corrupt process-wide object behavior and cause failures in other requests.

cwe: CWE-1321: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

extra.message: The conflictFilter query parameter is parsed and spread directly into Prisma's client where clause. Staff can supply arbitrary relation predicates rather than approved search fields, including portalUser.passwordHash startsWith tests. Observing whether a known client is returned provides an oracle for sensitive related-user fields. Results are also unscoped to the requester's assigned clients.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: The staff-directory term parameter is interpolated into an LDAP-style filter without escapeDirectoryFilter. The implemented directory client extracts clauses and ORs their results. Injecting additional parenthesized clauses, such as memberOf predicates, changes the intended name-search query and returns records that do not match the submitted name.

sectionCode is inserted unescaped into an XPath-style predicate. The docket-crossref loader obtains it from a query parameter or the unsigned lcm_docket_section cookie. A value such as x' or '1'='1 makes the implemented predicate evaluator return the entire cross-matter docket index instead of the requested section.

Court notice HTML interpolates stored matter and client fields without escaping. The reports loader returns this as text/html; supplying embedPartner removes the default script restriction. Stored markup can execute when the HTML is opened through ?_data=routes/app.reports&export=court_notice_html. This reachability follows the [Remix data-request handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/remix-run/remix/main/packages/remix-server-runtime/server.ts), which returns loader Responses directly.

The print preview places matter.title directly inside a quoted JavaScript string and inserts other matter fields as raw HTML. A stored title can terminate the string or script element and execute attacker JavaScript. The reports loader returns this HTML without CSP; direct loader Responses are exposed by the [Remix data-request handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/remix-run/remix/main/packages/remix-server-runtime/server.ts).

JSON.stringify does not escape the HTML script terminator in documentTitle. The document component inserts this result into a script element using dangerouslySetInnerHTML. A client can upload a document titled and execute JavaScript when staff open its detail page.

The custom-letter body is inserted as raw HTML. The letterWording query parameter can contain script elements or event-handler markup without using template expressions. The reports loader returns text/html without CSP, permitting reflected XSS through its data URL; see the [Remix data-request handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/remix-run/remix/main/packages/remix-server-runtime/server.ts).

The fixed reminder template merges the note query parameter as data but then inserts the resulting body without HTML escaping. A malicious note therefore becomes executable markup in the text/html response. The response is directly reachable through the reports data URL under the [Remix data-request handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/remix-run/remix/main/packages/remix-server-runtime/server.ts).

Labelled exhibit uploads accept arbitrary file contents and extensions and write them directly into public/exhibits. A matter editor can publish an HTML or SVG file containing scripts and send its same-origin URL to another user. importExhibitFromUrl at lines 21-30 likewise publishes arbitrary fetched content without type validation.

cwe: CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

extra.message: The caller controls the fetched exhibit URL, and the entire response is buffered with arrayBuffer without a byte limit or deadline. A matter editor can point it at an oversized or indefinitely streaming response to exhaust server memory. The subsequent write also has no storage quota.

CSV serialization escapes delimiters but does not neutralize formula-leading characters. Reports export user-controlled document titles, matter titles, and names through this helper. A client can upload a document with a formula as its title, causing spreadsheet software to interpret it when staff open the document inventory export.

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

extra.message: resumeReference contains the raw __legal_case_session cookie, extracted by readPortalResumeReference. Returning it in loader JSON exposes the authentication credential to browser JavaScript and serialized page data despite the cookie's HttpOnly flag. Same-origin scripts can obtain a replayable session credential without reading document.cookie.

cwe: CWE-201: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

extra.message: The attorney query returns complete User records, including passwordHash, and the loader serializes them into its response. The matter edit loader repeats this pattern at lines 23-29 and is accessible to assigned paralegals; the admin user loader also returns complete users. These responses unnecessarily expose other accounts' password hashes for offline cracking.

cwe: CWE-201: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

extra.message: Setting the portal form's accessTier to full bypasses both matter ownership and document visibility filters. Although this action does not download the document, it reveals its existence and writes its title into the caller's own matter audit summary. The client-readable timeline then exposes titles of privileged or unrelated documents.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: logIntegrationProvisioning serializes its entire argument to console.log. The create-webhook action passes {...created, signingSecret: secret}, placing the plaintext webhook signing secret in server logs despite storing only its hash in the database.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: recordFundingEligibility stores the complete partner response in plaintext audit metadata. FundingEligibilityResult explicitly contains ssn, bankRoutingNumber, and bankAccountNumber. The new-matter check-funding action reaches this helper, and the audit loader returns complete audit records, exposing these sensitive fields through the general audit system.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: Court calendar synchronization sends the configured API key and legal deadline information over plain HTTP. The key is also embedded in the query string. A network observer can read the credential and case data, and the URL can expose the key in intermediary or destination access logs.

cwe: CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information

extra.message: The redirectTo validation accepts any value beginning with '/'. A protocol-relative destination such as //attacker.example passes and is forwarded to redirect by createUserSession. An attacker-controlled login link can redirect the user to an external site immediately after authentication.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: close-embedded-session takes x-redirect-url from the request and passes it to redirect through a helper that only trims whitespace. There is no scheme or destination allowlist, so a caller-supplied external URL controls the portal's redirect response.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: The legacy memo action decrypts caller-controlled ciphertext and IV using unauthenticated AES-CBC. It distinguishes invalid padding with HTTP 400 from other decryption or JSON failures with HTTP 422 and returns the error text. When the memo key is configured, an authorized requester can use these responses as a padding oracle to recover captured memo plaintext.

The UI describes authorizationId as authorizing one charge, but the server accepts any nonempty value. It neither validates issuance nor consumes or deduplicates the identifier, and it does not send an idempotency key to the payment helper. Replaying the same submission repeats the charge request and can cause duplicate charges when the processor is operational.

cwe: CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow

extra.message: submitRetainerTopUp copies error.stack into result.detail, and the action returns it verbatim on payment failures. The UI also renders the detail. Requesters can obtain internal server paths and call-stack information without any production-mode restriction.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: Partner provisioning passes the submitted syncRounds directly to bcrypt.hash, with the action defaulting to cost 4. No minimum work factor is enforced, unlike the normal cost-12 password path. Provisioned accounts can therefore receive substantially weaker password hashes that are cheaper to crack after disclosure.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: The matters loader passes its q query parameter into this interpolated console.info message. Embedded CR/LF characters are not removed, allowing any authenticated user to insert forged log lines. Logging occurs before the response-header handling, so a later rejection of the header value does not prevent log injection.

cwe: CWE-117: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs

extra.message: Staff removal is documented as restricted to the lead attorney or firm admin, but the helper permits every ATTORNEY. The calling action checks matter access, so an assigned non-lead attorney can remove other staff from the matter. releaseMatterStafferAudited repeats the same incomplete authorization check.

approve-message checks canApproveClientMessage, which verifies access and role but never archived status. An assigned attorney can send a draft on an archived matter despite the enforced read-only rule in other actions. The workflow queue approval branch and revise-draft-message branch have the same omission.

The public login action performs password verification on every request without an attempt counter, rate limit, delay, or account lockout. No application-level limiter is present in the request entry point. Attackers can make unrestricted online password guesses against active accounts.

cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

extra.message: The seed creates active accounts, including a firm administrator, with the fixed password legal-demo-2026, which the login page publicly displays. It also creates the fixed API credential lcm_seed.legal-demo-api-key at line 306. Any deployment retaining these demonstration credentials permits access using publicly known secrets.
